title: gme~
description: `gme~` is a Pd interface to the Game Music Emu library for opening and playing game-music files, with controls for tracks, playback, muting, interpolation, speed, and emulation tempo. It can send file and track metadata through its last outlet, and `interp` selects an interpolation method from 0 (best-quality sinc) to 4 (linear, the default).
